contract_question: Will a bounded LeanHammer smoke benchmark over v19.22 mapped rows run in the external LeanHammer clone without mutating the main project and produce per-row pass/fail/suggestion artifacts?
rationale_short: Bounded run is plausible because LeanHammer is built, but v19.22 has zero high-confidence mappings. The primary risk is converting medium/low mapping candidates into valid LeanHammer inputs and usable artifacts.
